how_to_apply: This is a walk-in interview recruitment; there is no online application (apply online) process specified in the notification. Candidates must follow these steps:
Download/obtain the application form enclosed with the advertisement and fill it completely before the registration process.
Walk-in and register for the interview between 9:00 AM and 10:30 AM on 16.09.2026; no candidate will be entertained after 10:30 AM.
Report by 9:00 AM at the interview venue on the scheduled dates.

Carry all original certificates with one set of self-attested photocopies, 2 passport-size photographs, and category-specific certificates in the prescribed Government of India format, if claiming reservation.
Produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, if applicable, on the day of the interview.
Candidates applying for multiple cadres/posts must submit separate applications along with the requisite fee for each.

No photocopies will be arranged or provided by the office under any circumstances, and applications in any format other than the prescribed one, or incomplete applications, will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kalaburagi Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), ESIC Medical College, PGIMSR & Hospital, Kalaburagi has officially released Notification No. 532/GLBMC/A/12/12/RCT-SR/2025 dated 03 September 2026 for recruitment of Teaching Faculty and Senior Residents. The notification includes complete details on department-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria as per NMC norms, age limits, salary, application fee, required documents, walk-in registration, selection process and terms and conditions of contractual engagement. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notification before appearing for the walk-in interview. The notification is available on the official ESIC website. Download ESIC Kalaburagi Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Official Website

rows.details: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
Teaching Faculty (Professor, Associate Professor); Senior Resident (SR)
Contractual - Faculty: 1 year, extendable up to 3 years; SR: 1 year
Walk-in (offline application form); not an online application process

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kalaburagi Teaching Faculty & SR Important Dates
content_sections.text: The registration and interview will be held on two separate days as per the official notification. No candidate will be entertained for registration after 10:30 AM on 16.09.2026, and candidates are advised to report by 9:00 AM at the venue on the scheduled dates.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kalaburagi Teaching Faculty & SR Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Vacancies are spread across 11 Super Specialty departments and are category-wise (UR, OBC, SC, ST). As per the notification, the number of vacancies is provisional and may increase or decrease without prior intimation.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kalaburagi Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Qualification and experience for Professor and Associate Professor posts are as per NMC (National Medical Commission) Norms published in the Gazette of India dated 30.06.2025 and 04.07.2025. Qualification and experience for the Senior Resident post are also as per NMC Norms published in the Gazette of India dated 30.06.2025 and 04.07.2025. The notification does not specify the exact degree-wise qualification content beyond referencing these NMC Gazette norms; candidates are advised to check the NMC norms directly for department-wise qualification details.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kalaburagi Qualification & Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must produce original certificates and self-attested photocopies (one set) at the time of the walk-in interview, including: SSC / 10th Standard Certificate (as proof of age) MBBS Certificate Postgraduate Certificate Super specialty qualification certificate in the respective specialty, as applicable Registration with the Karnataka State Medical Council (KMC) / NMC Caste Certificate issued by the Competent Authority, if applicable Experience Certificate Relieving Certificate from the previous institution Proof of ID (Aadhar Card and PAN Card) Two passport-size photographs Other documents/publications as per NMC criteria for faculty appointment

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kalaburagi Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kalaburagi Salary 2026 (Pay & Allowances)
content_sections.text: ESIC has adopted a consolidated remuneration structure for contractual faculty, as per ESIC Headquarters letters dated 13.04.2022 and 08.12.2022 (updated from time to time). Travelling Allowance (TA) and Dearness Allowance (DA) on TA are payable as applicable. The notification also states there is no claim for services such as PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Seniority, Promotion or Leave, although selected faculty are entitled to Earned Leave and Half Pay Leave as admissible to a temporary Government servant under the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972, and Senior Residents are entitled to 2.5 Casual Leave on completion of a calendar month.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kalaburagi Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Applications submitted on the day of the walk-in interview, along with the requisite fee, are scrutinized by the Institute's scrutiny committee; only eligible candidates are allowed to appear before the selection committee. If the number of applicants is large, the selection committee may devise shortlisting criteria, which may include a Screening Test. 50% of the total marks is the criterion for eligibility for selection. Selection is made on the basis of a personal interview conducted by a duly constituted selection board. Selected candidates report for Medical Examination and verification of original certificates after receiving a provisional offer of appointment through email. The offer of appointment is provisional, subject to verification of original certificates at the time of joining. A waiting list is prepared and remains valid for 2 months from the date of the result, subject to approval of the Competent Authority. The final result is published on the official website: https://www.esic.gov.in/recruitments.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Kalaburagi Teaching Faculty & SR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: This is a walk-in interview recruitment; there is no online application (apply online) process specified in the notification. Candidates must follow these steps: No photocopies will be arranged or provided by the office under any circumstances, and applications in any format other than the prescribed one, or incomplete applications, will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kalaburagi Walk-in Interview Venue & Contact Details
content_sections.text: ESIC reserves the right to change the venue and dates of the interview, if needed, and to cancel the recruitment process at any stage at its discretion.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kalaburagi EWS Reservation Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates not covered under the SC/ST/OBC reservation scheme, whose family's gross annual income is below Rs. 8.00 Lakh, may be identified as Economically Weaker Section (EWS). Families owning agricultural land of 5 acres or more, a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or above, or specified residential plot sizes in notified or other municipalities are excluded from EWS status regardless of income. The EWS benefit requires an Income and Asset Certificate issued by a Competent Authority as specified in the notification. Candidates with MBBS and postgraduate/super-speciality medical qualifications can also explore more Medical Government Jobs and Senior Resident Jobs available across India. Candidates looking for opportunities in Karnataka can also explore the latest Karnataka Government Jobs and Kalaburagi Government Jobs. Medical professionals interested in teaching and hospital careers can check more Medical College Jobs, Faculty Jobs and ESIC Recruitment opportunities matching their qualifications.

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Kalaburagi Teaching Faculty & SR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview recruitment by ESIC Medical College, PGIMSR & Hospital, Kalaburagi, for engaging Teaching Faculty (Professor, Associate Professor) and Senior Residents (SR) on a contractual basis in Super Specialty departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Kalaburagi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 58 total vacancies: 9 Professor, 8 Associate Professor, and 41 Senior Resident posts, spread across 11 departments. The notification states these numbers are provisional and may change.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Kalaburagi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online "last date"; instead, registration for the walk-in interview takes place on 16.09.2026 between 9:00 AM and 10:30 AM, and the interview is on 17.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for ESIC Kalaburagi Teaching Faculty and SR posts?
faq.answer: Qualification and experience for both Faculty and SR posts are as per NMC Norms published in the Gazette of India dated 30.06.2025 and 04.07.2025. Specific subject/degree requirements are not detailed in this notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ESIC Kalaburagi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Teaching Faculty candidates must be less than 69 years and Senior Resident candidates less than 45 years of age (including all category relaxations) on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Kalaburagi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 300/- for general category candidates, payable by Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Corporation" payable at Kalaburagi. SC/ST candidates and female candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for ESIC Kalaburagi Teaching Faculty & SR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no apply online option. Candidates must fill the prescribed application form enclosed with the advertisement and submit it in person at the walk-in interview venue, along with the fee and required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ESIC Kalaburagi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through scrutiny of applications followed by a personal interview conducted by a duly constituted selection board; a screening test may be held if there are too many applicants, and 50% of total marks is the eligibility criterion.
